<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 147.00, 133.90, 128.91 (appearing twice), and 127.68 (appearing twice). The duplicated peaks indicate two equivalent carbons each. Summing them gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
